1–2 hours (not counting the 6666 Demons task for the Holy Icon)

The {wiki:Ruthless Seven|Ruthless Seven} have sent a powerful demonic being to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc|Plains of Havoc}: the {wiki:The Demon Oak|Demon Oak}, a living tree trapped in an infested area. You go in with a {item:Holy Icon}, ask {npc:Oldrak} to bless an axe and chop the tree's four weak spots while it summons undead, critters and, at the end, a {creature:Demon}. You earn the achievement **Herbicide**, choose one of four rewards ({item:Demon Legs}, {item:Rainbow Shield}, {item:Spellbook of Ancient Arcana} or {item:Thorn Spitter}) and become eligible for the second Demon Outfit addon.
The Ruthless Seven have sent a powerful demonic being to the Plains of Havoc. Do you have what it takes to stop it?
Demon Oak infested area, Plains of Havoc
**Level 120** to be able to enter the infested area (there is no level door, but the game checks your level); **130+** recommended.

A {item:Holy Icon}: it is the reward of {npc:Grizzly Adams}'s 6666 {creature:Demon|Demons} task ({wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest|Killing in the Name of... Quest}), which only opens at the **Elite Hunter** rank (100 points, level 130). The item is **tradeable**, so you can also buy it from another player on the Market.
A normal {item:Axe} and **1,000 gp** for {npc:Oldrak} to turn it into a {item:Hallowed Axe}.
lets you enter the infested area and disappears after that
a simple axe (20 gp in weapon shops, for example Romella in Venore)
donation to Oldrak for the Hallowed Axe
made by Oldrak during the quest; turns back into a normal Axe after a short time
Lots of health potions: each hit on the tree takes 300 health from you (Earth damage)
Area runes/spells for the summons (undead and a Demon at the end)
One reward of your choice: {item:Demon Legs}, {item:Rainbow Shield}, {item:Spellbook of Ancient Arcana} or {item:Thorn Spitter}
You become able to receive the second addon (helmet) of the {wiki:Demon Outfits|Demon Outfit}
Second addon (helmet) of the Demon Outfit
After you fell the Demon Oak and talk to {npc:Oldrak}.
Keep the {item:Holy Icon} until you reach the infested area: it is what lets you in and it disappears after you use it. {npc:Grizzly Adams} only gives it **once**.

The blessing of the {item:Hallowed Axe} is absorbed by the demonic energy and does not last long: when you receive it, go straight to the tree. If it turns back into a normal {item:Axe}, {npc:Oldrak} blesses it again whenever you ask him.
Each hit on one of the weak spots takes **300 health** from you (Earth damage). Equipment with Earth protection and plenty of potions make the fight easier.
Decide before you start which of the four spots you will leave for last: the 10th hit on that last spot always summons a {creature:Demon} instead of that spot's usual creatures.
Without the {item:Holy Icon} you cannot enter the Demon Oak area. The axe just needs to be an ordinary {item:Axe}.

The {item:Holy Icon} is the reward of the **6666 {creature:Demon|Demons}** task of the {wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest|Killing in the Name of... Quest}. Reach the **Elite Hunter** rank in the Paw and Fur (100 points, level 130) and go to {npc:Grizzly Adams} in **Port Hope** (by boat: say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to a harbour captain). Say {key:hi}, {key:task}, {key:demon} and {key:yes}. {creature:Infernal Demon|Infernal Demons} also count. When you finish the 6666 kills, come back and say {key:hi}, {key:task} to receive the icon. Alternatively, buy it from another player on the Market (it is tradeable).
Grizzly Adams only gives you the Holy Icon once. Do not sell or lose it before entering the infested area.

Buy a simple {item:Axe} in a weapon shop (it costs **20 gp**). In **Venore**, the closest city to the Plains of Havoc, {npc:Romella} sells it. You can also use an Axe you looted from creatures. Also bring **1,000 gp** to pay {npc:Oldrak} for the blessing.
First you have to enter the {wiki:The Demon Oak|Demon Oak} area once with the {item:Holy Icon}. Only then will {npc:Oldrak} make you the blessed axe.
Get to the Plains of Havoc

The {wiki:Plains of Havoc|Plains of Havoc} are in the south of the continent, **south-west of Venore** and south-east of Kazordoon. If you are not in Venore, take a boat there (for example, at the Thais harbour say {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to the captain). Leave **Venore** and walk **south-west** to the plains. The Plains of Havoc temple, where {npc:Oldrak} is (1 floor above the ground), is your landmark and resting place.
Map of the Plains of Havoc: 1. Temple, 7. Infected Area, 8. Demon Oak
Around the Plains of Havoc there are {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} and other creatures that are dangerous for low levels.

From the temple, head **south-west** to the infested area (*Infected Area*): a closed circle surrounded by many {item:Dead Tree|dead trees}, **east** of the {wiki:Dark Cathedral|Dark Cathedral} and **north** of the {creature:Vampire|vampires}' house. Around the area there are 5 squares that make the Demon Oak shout when you walk over them (lines such as *"Release me and you will be rewarded greatefully!"*). Look for the **1 sqm corridor** that leads to the centre.
1st square around the infested area that makes the Demon Oak shout
The {creature:Vampire|Vampires} from the house to the south roam nearby.

With the {item:Holy Icon} in your inventory and **level 120 or higher**, walk through the 1 sqm corridor: you are teleported into the infested area and receive the message *"It seems that you have discovered an 'Ultimate Challenge'"*. In the Quest Log, this quest is called **The Ultimate Challenges**. The Holy Icon disappears after letting you in.
Entrance corridor of the infested area
Do **not** attack the tree yet: without the {item:Hallowed Axe} you cannot harm it.

Once you have discovered it, leave the infested area and return to the Plains of Havoc temple, to the **north-east** ({coord:32816,32260,6}). TibiaWiki only says that you have to leave, without describing how: go back the same way, through the 1 sqm corridor you came in by.
If you cannot get out that way, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple, but it does not work in No-Logout Zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block.

Go to the Plains of Havoc temple (1 floor above the ground) and talk to {npc:Oldrak}. Say {key:hi}, {key:demon oak}, {key:axe} and confirm with {key:yes}. He takes your {item:Axe} and **1,000 gp** and gives you back a {item:Hallowed Axe}.

The blessing does not last long: the Hallowed Axe turns back into a normal Axe. Go to the tree right away. If the blessing runs out, go back to Oldrak: he says he can renew the blessing as many times as you like (repeat {key:axe} and {key:yes}).
The tree has **4 weak spots**. You attack each one with the {item:Hallowed Axe} until it is "dead" (smoke comes out). Each hit costs you 300 health and the tree keeps summoning creatures.

With the {item:Hallowed Axe} in your inventory, go back **south-west** of the temple to the infested area and enter again through the 1 sqm corridor. The Holy Icon was already used up on the first entry; according to the {wiki:Infected Area|Infected Area} page, to enter you need to have started the quest, which you already have.

The spots where you have to use the axe are: **1.** the **left** spiky ball, **2.** the **bird**, **3.** the tree's **face** and **4.** the **right** spiky ball. You can do them in any order you like.
The 4 spots where to use the Hallowed Axe
Attack a spot until it dies

Use the {item:Hallowed Axe} on one of the spots (*Use with* on the tree's spot). Each hit takes **300 health** from you in **Earth** damage. Once you start on a spot, keep hitting **that same spot** until it is "dead": a cloud of smoke comes out. Only then move on to the next spot.
Heal between hits: 300 damage per hit, plus the summoned creatures, adds up very quickly.

Depending on the spot and the hit number, the {wiki:The Demon Oak|Demon Oak} summons different creatures. On hits **1–4** and **6–9** it is random: either nothing appears, or **4 {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}** appear. On hits 5 and 10 the summon is fixed:
Kill the summons before you keep hitting, so you do not pile up creatures.

On the **last** of the four spots, the 10th hit **always summons 1 {creature:Demon}** instead of that spot's creatures. For example: if you leave the face for last, the Demon appears instead of the {creature:Undead Dragon} and the {creature:Hand of Cursed Fate}; if you leave the left ball for last, the Demon appears instead of the two {creature:Betrayed Wraith|Betrayed Wraiths}.
The {creature:Demon} is the strongest enemy in the quest. Save potions and runes for this moment.

When all four spots are dead, the tree is 100% dead and you can leave the area: go back the same way, through the 1 sqm corridor you came in by (TibiaWiki does not describe another exit). **When you leave** you receive the achievement **Herbicide** and the message *"Tell Oldrak about your great victory against the demon oak."*

Go back to the Plains of Havoc temple and say {key:hi} and {key:demon oak} to {npc:Oldrak}. He tells you the secret of the Daramian noble **Teme Saiyid** and of the grave **'Yesim Adeit'**, near an old house south of where you found the Demon Oak.
Go to the Yesim Adeit grave

Go down from the temple, head **south-west** to the infested area and continue **south** to the grave with the name **"Yesim Adeit"** (it reads *"Yes I made it"*). There may be a {item:Star Herb} growing on top of it: pick it or move it out of the way first.
Use the grave: you are taken to the reward room. Choose **one** of the four items:
All vocations, no minimum level (legs, Arm: 9)
One of these: {item:Demon Legs}, {item:Rainbow Shield}, {item:Spellbook of Ancient Arcana} or {item:Thorn Spitter}
You can only choose **one** item. Think carefully before choosing.
Leave the room and return to Venore

TibiaWiki does not describe how to leave the reward room. Look for the exit in the room itself; if you cannot find it, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} (it takes you to your temple, but does not work in No-Logout Zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block). Once back on the Plains of Havoc, walk back **north-east** to **Venore**.

If you have at least the first rank of the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest|Dreamer's Challenge Quest} (Novice/Maggot), a Premium account and an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} with you, you can use the teleports on the 2nd floor of the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower|Knightwatch Tower}, in the south of the Plains of Havoc, to go to Thais or Carlin. Enter through the hole a little north of the tower, under a tree next to the water ({coord:32816,32322,7}).
6. After the quest: Demon Outfit addon
Ask Avar Tar for the helmet

With the Demon Oak done **and** the 6666 {creature:Demon|Demons} kills, you can ask {npc:Avar Tar} in **Edron** for the second addon (helmet) of the {wiki:Demon Outfits|Demon Outfit} (by boat: say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to a harbour captain). Say {key:hi}, {key:outfits}, {key:yes} and {key:helmet} to him. See the {wiki:Demon Outfits Quest|Demon Outfits Quest} guide for the base outfit and the first addon.
The {item:Holy Icon} disappears after letting you into the infested area, and {npc:Grizzly Adams} does not give a second one.
The {item:Hallowed Axe} cannot be sold and turns back into a normal {item:Axe} after a short time.
In the dialogue, {npc:Oldrak} asks for a donation of **1,000 gp**; the Hallowed Axe page on TibiaWiki says 1,020 gp. Bring a little extra, to be safe.
**Herbicide** is a secret achievement worth 8 points.
